title: Corrupting Wings Gemling Build Guide: Corrupting Cry, Quality Stacking and Progression
summary: 0.5.4 warcry toolkit: Corrupting Cry became a triggered skill in 0.5, scaled by warcry level/quality/supports. Covers life management, cooldown breakpoints, Cast on Dodge and the high-investment Block tier.
description: Path of Exile 2 Corrupting Wings Gemling Legionnaire guide for 0.5.4: Corrupting Cry trigger, quality stacking, warcry timeline, life management and real video timestamps.

imageAlt: Mercenary Gemling Legionnaire shouting a Warcry that triggers Corrupted Blood across the battlefield

sections.title: Build Overview
paragraphs: Corrupting Wings Gemling is the Mercenary warcry toolkit: shouting a Warcry triggers Corrupting Cry, stacking Corrupted Blood (chaos/physical DoT) on enemies in range. The Gemling Legionnaire ascendancy turns Quality directly into attributes and damage, so 'quality stacking' is the core scaling lever.

In 0.5 Corrupting Cry became a triggered skill — it is no longer a manually pressed main skill but triggered by the Warcry. Damage therefore comes from warcry level, support gems, quality and Gemling's attribute conversion, not single casts.

This guide explains the warcry timeline, life management, cooldown breakpoints and the high-investment Block tier, with all client numbers flagged for PC verification. 0.5 launch bugs and later fixes are kept separate.
bullets: Warcry triggers Corrupting Cry → Corrupted Blood stacks.
Gemling quality stacking converts attributes and damage.
Post-0.5 Corrupting Cry is triggered, not a manual main skill.

sections.title: Pros and Cons
pros: Warcry-triggered clear is near one-button, great screenwide feel.
Quality stacking pays off hugely on Gemling.
High-investment Block (e.g. Svalinn) gives strong error margin.
Mobility (Cast on Dodge / Decree of Flight) is flexible.
cons: Early life and Mana management is tight.
Cooldown and roll rhythm needs practice.
High-investment tier needs specific Uniques, high gate.
0.5 launch bugs affected feel; confirm fixed.

sections.title: How the Loop Reads: Warcry → Trigger
paragraphs: Shout Fortifying Cry for self guard/echo buffs and to trigger Corrupting Cry stacks; Corrupted Blood jumps between enemies.
Decree of Flight and Cast on Dodge give mobility: the former takes off actively, the latter triggers on dodge, reducing standing still.
High-investment uses Wings / double Cast on Dodge for longer dashes; the normal version rolls. Same loop structure, difference is error margin and travel.
bullets: Fortifying Cry → triggers Corrupting Cry stacks.
Decree of Flight / Cast on Dodge give mobility.
High-investment = longer dash and more margin.

steps.label: Levels 1–14
body: Map with basic shots/grenades; Warcry is filler defense once unlocked.

steps.label: Levels 15–29
body: Take Fortifying Cry, start triggering extra damage with Warcry; add life/resist nodes.

steps.label: Levels 30–42 — Gemling Unlocks
body: Pick Gemling Legionnaire; quality starts converting attributes; Corrupting Cry trigger chain forms.

steps.label: Levels 43–60 — Early Maps
body: Run the warcry loop on low budget; fix life/resist, manage Mana and cooldown.

steps.label: Level 60+ — Endgame Prep
body: Push warcry level/quality, cooldown and Block; chase high-end Uniques after the checklist passes.

sections.title: Mapping
paragraphs: Shout Fortifying Cry at packs to trigger Corrupting Cry; Corrupted Blood jumps between enemies for clear; reposition with Decree of Flight / roll.
Trash does not need careful stacks; only rares/bosses need focused triggers. When clear slows, upgrade warcry level and quality first.
bullets: Upgrade warcry level/quality when clear slows.

sections.title: Bossing
paragraphs: Pre-read boss movement, shout Fortifying Cry to trigger Corrupting Cry, stack Corrupted Blood on the boss; use Decree of Flight to avoid ground effects.
If damage stalls, the issue is warcry level/quality/supports, not the main hand; high-investment uses Svalinn / double Cast on Dodge for margin and dash.
bullets: Fortifying Cry → Corrupting Cry focused stacks.
Stall = fix warcry, not swap weapon.

sections.title: Life Management
paragraphs: Tight early life is a real bottleneck: the Warcry itself does not heal, and sustained trigger plus mobility cost Mana. Secure life pool and resistances before damage.
The high-investment Block tier thins hits via block, easing life pressure; but block needs gear, not available at start. Exact numbers pending PC verification.
bullets: Block thins hits but needs gear.

items.question: Is Corrupting Cry still a manual main skill?
answer: Post-0.5 it is triggered by the Warcry; damage comes from level/quality/supports, not single casts.

items.question: Can I play without Svalinn?
answer: Yes; Svalinn is the high-investment Block core, the normal version uses life/resist and roll to map and boss most content.

items.question: I swapped a better weapon but still weak?
answer: Damage comes from warcry level/quality/supports, not the main hand; fix warcry and quality stacking first.
